extraction.Name: Jesse Howell
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record in Pawnee County; receipted for: Yes
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged for $1500; Land sale to Milam Bros. for $9000 and paid off mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: income of $5.00 per year from inherited land and get annuity paid to Pawnee tribe
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at Agency. Good price received for the land. Date of redemption expired: yes, released. No evidence of fraud in connection with this case. No property or funds accumulated. Wife and five children dependent upon him. Health fair. Notarized November 26, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; notary commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
